title: ImmobilienScout24 Property Details Scraper
description: Get ImmobilienScout24 listing details such as rent, rooms, address, features, energy class, and images by property ID. Batch IDs to enrich housing records or review German listings.

batch.title: Property IDs
batch.description: Numeric ImmobilienScout24 listing IDs to look up.

fixture.title: Bright two-bedroom apartment near Stadtpark

storeCopy.seoDescription: Get ImmobilienScout24 property details, rent, rooms, address, features, and images by listing ID. Enrich property records and analyze German rentals.
storeCopy.intro: Look up an ImmobilienScout24 listing by property ID. Review rent, rooms, address, features, energy class, and images in one structured record.
useCases: Rental analysts can enrich listings with rent, location, room, and energy details.
Property managers can compare features and availability across German listings.
Real-estate teams can review listing images and advertiser information.
howToUse: Add one numeric property ID to `property_ids` for each listing.
Set `maxResults` to cap property records saved.
Match each dataset item to your property using its ID.

faqs.question: Which ID should I provide?
faqs.answer: Use the numeric ImmobilienScout24 listing ID from the property URL or listing reference.

fields.name: success
